::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 28th 1898  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library  Add MSS 54921: 247-8
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_942.qmd)
Many thanks for your [cheque](organizations/other_160.qmd) which was an agreeable surprise to me. I hope the experiment of cheapness will be successful.

The great day at Hursley is to be the 24th October so if we could have a few of the presentation copies of [John Keble’s parishes](cmy_books/cmybook_247.qmd), it would be a great boon  

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge
